notes: Hard: the agent must compile isqrt-then-Fibonacci-mod-2^32 into a strictly topological, size-capped (520 nodes) combinational operator network. Reasoning depth comes from the wraparound-safe restoring isqrt (guard the DIF with LESS/PICK) and the fast-doubling Fibonacci selected per input-dependent bit; quantitative_correctness is exact on every probed input including boundaries and near-squares. The grader re-evaluates the network with an independent interpreter on hidden inputs and separately executes the agent validator, so a papered-over circuit cannot pass.
